title: Senior Accountant, Intercompany and Consolidations
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's corporate structure is growing in both entity count and transaction complexity; through acquisitions, international expansion, and an increasingly intricate set of intercompany flows. Consolidations and intercompany is now a dedicated pillar within Corporate Accounting, and we are looking for a Senior Accountant to be its first hands-on builder, reporting to the Head of Consolidations & Intercompany.

This is a preparer's role with a designer's mandate. You will run the multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation and intercompany close in our system of record, and you will own the frameworks that make that close repeatable: elimination logic, cost-allocation models, transaction-flow documentation, and the automation that lets all of it scale as entities and acquisitions are added. The people who do well here can take a complex, ambiguous structure, distill it into something clear, and then build it so it runs the same way every month without them.

Success in this role is a balance of strategy and operations;  someone who closes the books accurately and on time, and who also leaves each close with fewer manual steps than the one before.

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and own the monthly and quarterly consolidation close in Workday, including intercompany eliminations, multi-currency translation, and consolidated reconciliations

• Own the intercompany sub-ledger end to end: transaction matching, settlement, balance confirmations, and resolution of out-of-balance positions across entities

• Design and maintain the cost-allocation model for shared costs, including pay-on-behalf-of and collect-on-behalf-of flows, and build it to be automatable and defensible

• Document intercompany transaction flows and maintain the single source of truth for entity structure, agreements, and elimination logic

• Partner with the Head of Consolidations & Intercompany to design the target operating model for the pillar, then build and codify it through operating procedures and controls

• Operationalize transfer-pricing arrangements with Tax and support FX and intercompany settlement processes with Treasury

• Integrate newly acquired entities into the consolidation and intercompany framework, working alongside M&A Finance Integration

• Identify and build automation across the consolidation and intercompany close - in Workday, in reporting tools, and with AI-assisted tooling such as Claude - with a bias toward removing manual work for good

• Prepare consolidation and intercompany audit support and serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors on this area

• Support technical accounting analysis on consolidation matters, including foreign currency and intercompany arrangements

Minimum qualifications

• Hands-on experience preparing a multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation close in an ERP, including intercompany eliminations and currency translation

• Working knowledge of US GAAP for consolidations, intercompany transactions, and foreign currency

• Experience building or materially redesigning an accounting process, model, or reconciliation - not only operating one that already existed

• Advanced spreadsheet and data-handling skills, with the ability to work confidently in large, multi-entity datasets

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications

• CPA, ACA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification

title: Feature Engineer (AI-native)
description:
The Mission

Voyagu is a travel operations platform , a large product that powers travel agencies end to end - trip economics, sales, ticketing, accounting and marketing - with a wide range of integrations with GDS and external services (payments, email, calls/SMS and more). Many kinds of users work inside it, from agents and searchers to back-office teams, and the agencies’ own clients interact with the platform through a separate web interface.

We're hiring a Feature Engineer, who owns features end to end and drives an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a daily engineering tool.

The Bet We're Making

We bet on speed of thinking and quality of work with an agent , not years of stack. We want an engineer who, with an AI agent, ships like a stronger engineer - because they lead the agent instead of clicking "accept."

You write a plan, break work into steps, verify each step, reason about the output, and give precise next instructions. You don't trust code you haven't verified. If your style is "generate it and click around the UI until it seems to work," this isn't for you - and vice versa.

You Care Why, Not Just How

You engage with the business problem, not just the ticket. You don't need to know travel - the domain is specific and nobody arrives knowing it. What matters is that you get curious about why a feature exists, who needs it, and what changes once it ships. When a business stakeholder comes to you, that conversation is interesting, not an interruption. That habit is a large part of what we're selecting for.

Tech Stack

•
Backend: Python (SQLAlchemy, GraphQL, PostgreSQL) - complex queries against a rich data model. Writing complex SQL itself is something an agent helps with. The judgment around it is on you.

•
Frontend: Angular - kept deliberately thin, with help available for the harder parts. You don’t need to be a frontend expert, just the kind of person who says “I’ll take the feature,” not “that’s not my layer.”

•
Agent: Claude Code / Cursor / Codex as a normal, daily tool (your choice of agent).

What You'll Do

• Own features end to end across the platform: economics, sales, ticketing, integrations and more.

• Build services in Python (SQLAlchemy, GraphQL, PostgreSQL) with correct transactional behavior.

• Integrate external systems: GDS, payments, email, calls/SMS and other services.

• Ship the full slice of a feature, including the Angular frontend when it needs it.

• Work with an AI agent daily - plan, steps, verification - owning quality, not volume of generated lines.

• Grow scope fast as the team and responsibilities expand.

What We're Looking For

• Solid backend development experience in Python .

• Strong understanding of database transactions and data correctness; comfortable with complex queries (mandatory) .

• Real, daily experience working with an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) - a requirement, not a plus .

• A disciplined process: planning, step-by-step work, verifying your own code.

• Genuine interest in the business behind the code - you can explain what problem a feature solved and who it served.

• Willingness and ability to work across the stack, including frontend. You own features, not layers.

• English B2+ (working level).

Why Voyagu

• A large, real product - a travel operations platform with many domains, so you get variety and depth, not one narrow corner.

• An AI-first engineering culture: the agent is the norm, not a banned tool.

• Fast-growing responsibility for people who deliver.

• Fully remote, start ASAP.

title: Human Resources/ Learning & Development Expert
description:
Role Title: HR, Learning & Development Expert - PowerPoint Review & Reconstruction
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging experienced HR, Learning & Development Experts to participate in a project focused on elevating executive-level presentation materials. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. You will receive images of business slides relating to HR, learning, and organizational development, then reconstruct and enhance them in Microsoft PowerPoint. A critical part of this opportunity is articulating both the improvements you make and the original choices you intentionally preserve, providing a thoughtful log for each task. Typical source materials may cover organization design, talent development, workforce planning, or compensation and benefits strategy. This project welcomes both industry practitioners and consultants, emphasizing factual accuracy and clear domain definitions.
Scope of Work

• Rebuild business slides from images using Microsoft PowerPoint, emphasizing clarity and professional design.

• Enhance content structure, data visualization, visual storytelling, and slide layout for senior or client audiences.

• Edit and refine slide content while preserving critical HR and L&D definitions, caveats, and data accuracy.

• Document, in detail, the rationale for both improvements implemented and original elements deliberately retained.

• Analyze and strengthen message hierarchy, supporting evidence, and exhibit selection for each slide.

• Handle diverse materials such as organization design decks, training modules, and compensation reviews.

• Deliver each assignment within an anticipated 1-2 hours, with volume varying by project sprint.

Preferred Qualifications

• 3+ years of proven expertise in HR, learning & development, organizational development, or workforce strategy.

• Demonstrated experience crafting executive-ready PowerPoint presentations for senior stakeholders or clients.

• Strong skills in slide reconstruction, data visualization, visual storytelling, and business communication.

• Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking, and content editing within HR and L&D subject matter.

• Ability to clearly explain message hierarchy, evidence-supported titles, and design choices.

• Comfort working independently in a project-based, sprint-driven context with variable volume.

• Prior experience with AI data training, evaluation, or rubric writing is a plus, but not required.
